name: Xerophyte
body:
Xerophyte

School transmutation [water]; Level adept 2, druid 2, hunter 2, shaman 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a cactus thorn)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area / Target see text
Duration 1 week or 24 hours (see text)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

You gently manipulate the essence of the target plants, rendering them less sensitive to drought. This spell can be cast on an area of vegetation or crops, or focused on a single plant creature.

Cast on an area, you affect plants within a 1-mile radius. Any effects of drought over the following week are reduced by half.

Cast on a plant creature, the spell protects them from dehydration for 24 hours. They gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against dehydrating effects (including blight and horrid wilting spells). If they successfully save against such an effect, they are treated as a non-plant creature when determining how they are affected.
